impact.text: All tokens accumulated in BuilderWallet can be stolen

precondition_sources.text: The owner initiates deployment of the BuilderWallet.
The owner's call has mempool visibility before execution.
The BuilderWallet address can be calculated using the public predictBuilderWallet(12345).

intent_sources.text: BuilderWallet.init() must be access-controlled so that only the authorized owner can initialize the wallet, and it must not be callable by anyone or multiple times.
The builderAdmin role must not be hijackable by an unauthorized party, so control over sweep() and accumulated tokens remains with the legitimate builderAdmin.
